producer.name: claude normalization
producer.ingestedFrom: model id and optional display name

transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: Status line model.id becomes a monitor replace of key observed, intent observed, plus display name when present. That monitor write is not passed through ClaudeRootModelGate.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: The parallel model:updated event is published only when admitStatusLine says the card changed. admitHook drops a root hook model whose id is unchanged, and drops PostModelSwitch when from_model is not the card currently reported.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: SessionStart model omits intent. PostModelSwitch to_model sets intent observed. OTLP api_request model sets intent observed and is fingerprinted per actor key.

transforms.name: adapter-step-3
transforms.effect: Launch options.model emits intent configured with provider anthropic.

transforms.name: adapter-step-4
transforms.effect: Child tasks copy task.model with intent observed. The child batch replaces the whole model family, so a task that omits model drops the previous child row.

transforms.name: adapter-step-5
transforms.effect: Transcript onBatch listeners are registered and never invoked. No transcript model:updated was found.
